role: Officer in Charge, The Vermilion Block
description: Runs the Directorate's own magic-using department out of the black-and-red building on Island Centre marked with a red diamond hazard placard. Extremely high proficiency as a spellcaster themself, and the one person on staff whose sign-off actually means something when a reagent shipment, a test, or a request for magical support from another department needs approving. Most staff know the Block exists; almost none of them know this person's day-to-day work, only that requests go through them and answers come back slowly, if at all.
designNotes: Placeholder role, not a character -- created 2026-09-13 alongside the location itself, following the standing convention (see range-safety-officer.json, hospital-chief-of-staff.json).
